about: Curated corrections to the client registry chains-client-feed builds from GET /repositories, from the one-by-one registry review. Served verbatim as `overrides`; the feed applies them after every build. Per repository id: exclude, keep/drop (chainIds), add ({chainId: kind}), url, role, poll, note. pending: verdicts the review was unsure of; not applied.
